channel.title: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?" - I'm just pretty new to this and want to know what you guys think I should read, like any essentials in your opinion?

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: Well, SCP-3001, SCP-5733 (this is so good), SCP-4001, maybe SCP-1730 is good too, and of the serie I SCP-093, SCP-914 are a good option to read. And the last SCP-4999, good luck reading and i wait that this be useful for you :)

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: I'm a huge fan of SCP-3000. It's got a good cross between mythology, Lovecraftian horror and tragedy. SCP-1678 gives off a very mysterious and pre-apocalyptic feel. And SCP-426 is just a brilliant idea.

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: I personally think most of the thousand articles are a good place to start. 5000 and 2000 are two of my favorite articles on the site.

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: I'm i'm recommending an SCP, I don't want them to freak out. So i'd recommend something slightly creepy or funny. Like maybe 914, 105, or 023.

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: You should also read some of the more popular scps like: 096, 939, 049, 076, 106, 999.

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded:
Make sure to check out the Site-Generated Recommended Reading thread, the User-Curated Lists, and the Top Rated New Pages! I've also got a list of personal recommendations on my sandbox site.

SCP-093 is pretty in-depth, SCP-1746's pretty quirky, and SCP-2922 is a very cool rabbit-hole.

item.title: Re: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: I think that SCP-507 is always a good read, its got some horror and some humor.

item.title: Any scp articles suggestions for someone new to scp?
item.content:encoded: Hey guys, I'm pretty new to this whole scp thing, anyone mind telling me some of their favorite articles or any they find essential? I have only read 963, 5040, 173 and 1471, I would love some suggestions!
